name: baseline-2026-09
description: The configuration running in production as of 2026-09-17, after the socratic-tutor rewrite (docs/socratic-tutor-plan.md) and the setup-flow gpt-5.4-pro -> split-phase change (docs/roadmap.md item 1). Not yet compared against any candidate -- this is the reference point.
_comment: prompt slug -> model. Applied by rewriting each prompts/<slug>.md file's `model:` frontmatter line. Slugs not listed here are left untouched (e.g. disabled/legacy prompts that intentionally have no model: line and fall back to settings.default_model).
_settings_comment: app/settings.py fields that pick a model but aren't sourced from prompt frontmatter. The apply script prints these as .env lines to set rather than writing .env directly (it may hold secrets / personal overrides).
